tools.name: myriade_list_databases
tools.description:
List databases configured in Myriade (paginated, sorted by name).

Returns paginated database connections with their IDs, names, engines,
and descriptions. Use the database ID with other tools.

tools.name: myriade_get_database_info
tools.description:
Get detailed information about a specific database connection.

Returns information about the database including its name, engine type,
description, write mode, and any AI memory notes.

tools.name: myriade_list_tables
tools.description:
List tables in a database (paginated, sorted by database/schema/name).

Returns a flat, paginated list of tables. Each item has database_name,
schema, and name fields. The response's `dialect` is the SQL dialect
to use with myriade_query on this database.

tools.name: myriade_get_table_schema
tools.description:
Get the column-level schema for a specific table.

Returns column names, data types, and descriptions for the table,
plus the SQL `dialect` to use with myriade_query on this database.
When the name is ambiguous across schemas, the candidates are returned
under `matches` instead — pass `schema_name`

tools.name: myriade_query
tools.description:
Execute a read-only SQL query against a database.

Write the SQL in the dialect of the target database's engine — see the
`dialect` field returned by myriade_list_tables and
myriade_get_table_schema, or the engine in myriade_list_databases.
Write operations (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP, etc.) are b

tools.name: myriade_get_query_results
tools.description:
Re-execute a saved Myriade query and return fresh results.

The query's SQL always re-runs under the caller's governance policies
(table permissions, column masking) — results are never served from
Myriade's cached snapshot.

Prefer this over myriade_query for recurring metrics (dashboards,
cockpits

tools.name: myriade_sample_data
tools.description:
Get sample rows from a table to understand the data.

Returns a random sample of up to ``limit`` rows (max 20).

tools.name: myriade_search_catalog
tools.description:
Search the data catalog for tables, columns, or terms by name/description.

Uses fuzzy matching and full-text search. Keep queries short
(1-2 words) for best results.

tools.name: myriade_read_asset
tools.description:
Get detailed information about a catalog object (table, column, schema,
or glossary term — assets and terms share one id space).

Returns the asset's description, tags, status, columns (for tables),
sample data, parent hierarchy, and activity feed; for a glossary term,
its definition, synonyms, rela

tools.name: myriade_update_asset
tools.description:
Update a catalog asset's documentation (requires edit rights).

- ``description`` replaces the existing description (auto-sets status to
  "draft" if status is null).
- ``tag_ids`` replaces all tags (accepts names or UUIDs; auto-creates
  missing tags).
- ``status`` is "draft" (needs review) or "pub

tools.name: myriade_request_catalog_change
tools.description:
Propose a catalog change for the data team to review (no edit rights needed).

Creates a reviewable suggestion routed to the asset's reviewers. Does NOT
change the published catalog until approved.

Use this instead of ``myriade_update_asset`` when you lack edit rights or
are not confident enough to

tools.name: myriade_list_reports
tools.description:
List or search reports (documents) written in Myriade.

Without ``query`` returns the most recently updated reports first; with
``query`` returns the best matches first. Only reports the caller may see
are returned. Read one with myriade_read_report.

tools.name: myriade_read_report
tools.description:
Read a report's full markdown content.

Applies the same visibility rule as the web app; a report the caller may
not see returns a "not found" error. Edit it with myriade_edit_report, or
have the analyst agent rework it with myriade_ask.

tools.name: myriade_create_report
tools.description:
Create a report owned by the caller, private until shared.

Share it with myriade_set_report_access(visibility="everyone"): an audit
zone or domain document joins the map only once organisation-wide.

tools.name: myriade_edit_report
tools.description:
Replace text in a report, as the caller (a version is recorded).

Read it first with myriade_read_report. A published report is editable
only by its owner or an org admin.

tools.name: myriade_update_report_title
tools.description: Rename a report (an audit zone takes its document's title).

tools.name: myriade_set_report_access
tools.description:
Change who can read a report: visibility (its owner only) and web
publication (its owner or an org admin).

tools.name: myriade_ask
tools.description:
Ask a natural language question about a database using Myriade's
data analyst agent.

The agent will explore the database schema, search the catalog, run SQL
queries, and analyze the results to answer your question. Use this for
complex analytical questions that require multiple steps; for simple
sc

tools.description:
Retrieve the result of a myriade_ask run.

Returns ``{"status": "completed", "answer": ...}`` once the analyst
agent has answered, or ``{"status": "running"}`` while it is still
working — keep polling in that case. ``{"status": "failed"}`` /
``{"status": "quota_exceeded"}`` carry the run's error. ``

tools.name: myriade_monitoring_overview
tools.description:
Snapshot of a database's monitoring board: check count, standing alerts
(open / acknowledged / known) with their headlines, recent notifications
and triage notes, followed by the open alerts as JSON — each with its
investigation and evidence while they fit, then as listing lines, with
``shown`` / ``

tools.name: myriade_get_check
tools.description:
Get a monitoring check (name, SQL, severity, cadence, status) and its
most recent run results, newest first.

On governed databases the SQL and evidence rows are redacted unless you
manage the database or authored the proposal.

tools.name: myriade_propose_check
tools.description:
Propose a monitoring check for the user to review in Myriade.

This creates a PROPOSAL, never an active check: nothing runs until a
database owner or org admin accepts it in the app. The SQL is test-run
once under your governance context to validate it.

Contract for ``check_sql``: it MUST return ro

tools.name: myriade_triage_alert
tools.description:
Triage an alert (requires manage access: database owner or org admin).

- ``resolve``: the underlying problem is handled or gone.
- ``acknowledge``: keep it standing with a ``statement`` of what is
  happening — only for a situation that may worsen.
- ``dismiss``: false positive / expected; refused

tools.name: myriade_audit_list_map
tools.description:
The organisation's audit value map: every domain (key, name, its
document, zone count), every active zone (slug, name, domain, verdict,
gain, star, last verified, its document) with its levers and their class
(quick_win, quick_action, waiting, project, long_term), the domain keys
zones use without a

tools.name: myriade_audit_read_zones
tools.description:
Zones as their page shows them: the record from the ```zone block, the
dated figures recorded on the zone, its levers in short (id, name, stage,
class, follow-up, estimate) and its document. A slug with no active zone
comes back under errors. A figure's query is shown only on connections
you may rea

tools.name: myriade_audit_read_levers
tools.description:
Levers as their page shows them: every field, the class, the human
follow-up (status, assignee, note) and the dated figures behind each. An
id that is no lever on the map comes back under errors. A query is shown
only on connections you may read.

tools.name: myriade_audit_record_lever
tools.description:
Create a lever in a zone of the audit map, or update one by its id (an
argument you omit keeps its value). Cite the returned id as <LEVER:id> in
the zone document. Its class is computed from effort × gain_delay ×
timing; the follow-up (status, assignee, note) is set on its page.

tools.name: myriade_audit_record_evidence
tools.description:
Record a dated figure backing a zone (or one of its levers), linked to
the query that computed it, on a connection you may read. Recording the
same label again on the same zone or lever replaces the figure.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: myriade_read_asset, myriade_monitoring_overview, myriade_propose_check · Private data: myriade_list_databases, myriade_get_database_info, myriade_list_tables, myriade_get_table_schema, myriade_query, myriade_list_reports, myriade_create_report, myriade_update_report_title, myriade_ask, myriade_monitoring_overview, myriade_get_check, myriade_propose_check, myriade_triage_alert, myriade_audit_list_map, myriade_audit_read_zones, myriade_audit_record_lever, myriade_audit_record_evidence · Public sink: myriade_read_asset, myriade_create_report, myriade_triage_alert · Destructive: myriade_query, myriade_get_query_results, myriade_ask, myriade_get_answer, myriade_get_check, myriade_propose_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: myriade_read_asset, myriade_monitoring_overview, myriade_propose_check · Private data: myriade_list_databases, myriade_get_database_info, myriade_list_tables, myriade_get_table_schema, myriade_query, myriade_list_reports, myriade_create_report, myriade_update_report_title, myriade_ask, myriade_monitoring_overview, myriade_get_check, myriade_propose_check, myriade_triage_alert, myriade_audit_list_map, myriade_audit_read_zones, myriade_audit_record_lever, myriade_audit_record_evidence · Public sink: myriade_read_asset, myriade_create_report, myriade_triage_alert · Destructive: myriade_query, myriade_get_query_results, myriade_ask, myriade_get_answer, myriade_get_check, myriade_propose_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
